information_requirement_traceability.description: Information regarding the expiration dates and freshness status of perishable goods, particularly relevant for items nearing their sell-by date.

business_requirements.name: BR-01: Maintain Accurate Expiry Data Integrity
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall ensure that expiry dates and shelf-life data for all perishable items are accurate, verifiable, and synchronized between the Store Partner and the Platform Operator to prevent the sale of unsafe products.
business_requirements.business_objective: To ensure product safety and compliance by preventing the sale of items past their sell-by date.
business_requirements.business_value: Mitigates liability risks associated with selling expired goods and protects brand reputation.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR explicitly states that 'Items past their sell-by date must be flagged for removal' and requires data to be 'accurate and verifiable by the store' and 'synchronized with the store's inventory system'.

origin.description: Information regarding the expiration dates and freshness status of perishable goods, particularly relevant for items nearing their sell-by date.

success_measures.measure: Percentage of orders containing items past their sell-by date
Frequency of data synchronization failures between Store Partner and Platform

policies_and_constraints: Items past their sell-by date must be flagged for removal.
Expiry dates must be accurate and verifiable by the store.
assumptions: Store Partners have the capability to provide accurate production and expiry dates.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Inaccurate data provided by Store Partners leads to unsafe product sales.
Dependency: Real-time synchronization with the Store Partner's inventory system.

business_requirements.name: BR-02: Optimize Inventory Turnover for Perishables
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall prioritize the allocation and sale of perishable inventory based on proximity to expiry dates to minimize waste and maximize margin on near-expiry goods.
business_requirements.business_objective: To reduce inventory shrinkage caused by spoilage and improve financial performance on perishable stock.
business_requirements.business_value: Reduces waste costs and increases revenue from items that would otherwise be discarded.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR states the business purpose is 'To prioritize the sale of perishable inventory' and 'minimize waste, maximize margin on near-expiry goods'. This implies a requirement for the system to actively manage allocation based on this data.

origin.description: Information regarding the expiration dates and freshness status of perishable goods, particularly relevant for items nearing their sell-by date.

success_measures.measure: Reduction in inventory shrinkage due to spoilage

policies_and_constraints: Promotions must be prioritized for items nearing expiry.
Shelf-life must be updated upon restocking or item transfer.
assumptions: The system can calculate time-to-expiry for active items in the catalog.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Failure to prioritize near-expiry items results in increased waste.
Dependency: Availability of 'Shelf-Life Remaining' and 'Expiry Date' data.

business_requirements.name: BR-03: Enable Dynamic Promotion Management
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall support the creation and execution of promotions specifically targeted at items approaching their sell-by date to recover value from perishable stock.
business_requirements.business_objective: To recover margin on near-expiry goods through targeted discounting and features.
business_requirements.business_value: Increases profitability on inventory that is at risk of becoming unsellable.
business_requirements.business_explanation: The IR states that 'Deciding whether to discount items approaching their sell-by date' is a business decision supported by the data, and 'Promotions must be prioritized for items nearing expiry'.

origin.description: Information regarding the expiration dates and freshness status of perishable goods, particularly relevant for items nearing their sell-by date.

success_measures.measure: Conversion rate of items in 'Best Before' promotions
Percentage of near-expiry items sold via promotions

policies_and_constraints: Promotions must be prioritized for items nearing expiry.
Discounts must be linked to specific expiry thresholds.
assumptions: Merchandisers have the authority to set discount thresholds based on expiry data.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Over-discounting may erode overall brand value or margin.

business_requirements.name: BR-04: Ensure Customer Freshness Assurance
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall ensure that customers receive goods within their expected shelf life by validating product freshness status prior to order fulfillment.
business_requirements.business_objective: To maintain customer trust and satisfaction by delivering fresh products.
business_requirements.business_value: Enhances customer experience and reduces returns/complaints related to product quality.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR states the business purpose includes 'ensure customers receive goods within their expected shelf life' and 'ensure product freshness for customers'.

origin.description: Information regarding the expiration dates and freshness status of perishable goods, particularly relevant for items nearing their sell-by date.

success_measures.measure: Customer satisfaction score regarding product freshness
Rate of returns due to product age or spoilage

policies_and_constraints: Item status must reflect the current age relative to expiry.
Quality Grade assessment must be available for customer visibility.
assumptions: Customers value freshness information when making purchasing decisions.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Shipping delays may cause items to spoil before delivery despite valid shelf-life at dispatch.
Dependency: Logistics system integration for transit time estimation.

business_requirements.name: BR-05: Provide Visibility for Merchandising Strategy
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall provide Merchandisers with actionable insights into perishability levels and quality grades to support catalog curation and strategy.
business_requirements.business_objective: To enable data-driven decisions on which items to feature, stock, or remove from the catalog.
business_requirements.business_value: Improves catalog relevance and operational efficiency in managing perishable inventory.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR states that 'Evaluated by the Merchandiser' and supports 'Product Catalog Curation and Strategy'. The data includes 'Perishability Level' and 'Quality Grade'.

origin.description: Information regarding the expiration dates and expiration dates and freshness status of perishable goods, particularly relevant for items nearing their sell-by date.

success_measures.measure: Time taken to curate catalog based on expiry data
Accuracy of merchandising decisions regarding perishable stock

policies_and_constraints: Perishability Level classification must be consistent.
Quality Grade assessment must be available for decision-making.
assumptions: Merchandisers require aggregated views of perishable inventory health.
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Inconsistent classification leads to poor merchandising decisions.
Dependency: Data enrichment by the Platform Operator.
